The Company

Halal processing built for international buyers.

Umme Yusra Global Foods (Pvt) Ltd is a Pakistani halal meat processing, manufacturing, and export company built for international buyers who require consistent quality, food safety discipline, and reliable cold-chain delivery.

From livestock sourcing through inspection, processing, and refrigerated dispatch, every stage is designed around hygiene, traceability, and consistent product quality.
